title: corvus
text: class="wk"> corvus from corvuspedia, the not-so-free encyclopedia corvus classification kingdom animalia order passeriformes family one big fam relatives pidgy habitat ghent, belgium function unknown status deceased (feb 2026) · revived (nov 2026) purpose unknown a corvus (latin: crow ) is a black, clever and slightly mysterious bird. in the wild, crows are known for solving puzzles and remembering faces. what the corvus of corvus.gent does exactly is still unknown. researchers are watching closely. contents history family purpose behaviour history it started as a small web studio from ghent, founded by a team of fellow students. the studio built websites with design thinking as priority no. 1. in february 2026 the corvus died. the domain did not. in november 2026 it was revived as the portfolio of gabe , where it still flies around looking for an honest man. family scientists place crows in the family corvidae and pigeons in columbidae . corvuspedia rejects this. the corvus and the pidgy are closely related and belong to the same family: one big fam . both are birds, both live in ghent, and both work for the same human. purpose what the corvus exactly does is unknown . researchers are still observing it. its relative at least flies into your inbox. behaviour the corvus is often seen near barrels and lanterns, see diogenes . it reacts to keyboards: press any key on the homepage . see also pidgy 402 payment required corvuspedia is the not-so-free, not-so-neutral encyclopedia of corvus.gent. edits are accepted from one (1) contributor.

title: pidgy
text: class="wk"> pidgy from corvuspedia, the not-so-free encyclopedia pidgy classification kingdom animalia (digital) order columbiformes family one big fam relatives corvus built by alkmist , ghent diet unread emails pidgy is a pigeon that flies into your inbox: pidgy-ai.com . more precisely, it is an ai inbox agent for outlook and gmail, built by alkmist in ghent. like real carrier pigeons, it makes sure messages get where they need to go, and that none of them get dropped. contents what it does family sightings what it does pidgy turns email chaos into a short list of what actually needs you. its natural habitat is pidgy-ai.com . a free trial week can be obtained here . family although pigeons are officially columbidae , the pidgy belongs to the same family as the corvus : one big fam . the corvus provides the mystery, the pidgy provides the inbox relief. sightings pidgies have been spotted all over corvus.gent: on fire on the army page , covered in sticky notes on /now , and building pages that don't exist yet. seven of its feathers are hidden on this website. see also corvus companies i support corvuspedia is the not-so-free, not-so-neutral encyclopedia of corvus.gent. edits are accepted from one (1) contributor.
